画像を使いたいときに使えないだけでなく、普通に会話することすら制限されるのであれば、何のために利用しているのかわかりません。

利用状況に応じた正確な制限管理と、制限が発生した理由をユーザーにも分かるように説明してほしいです。

楽しみに使っていたサービスですが、今回のようなことが続くのであれば、アンインストールも考えています。

なお、この意見書はChatGPT内のAIと利用者が問題点を確認・共有したうえで作成したものであり、AI自身も今回の制限のあり方に疑問を呈しています。

You start off the day with a set amount of energy and when you do questions, you lose energy points. Once you’re out of energy, you’re done- no more Duolingo. 

Now because that makes it unusable for scholars and sweats alike, you get random bits of energy replenished from time to time throughout the lesson.

You only get like 30% energy back and that’s only 3 energy for every 19 questions. 

Soooooooooo that’s where Duo Super comes in.

2) more lessons

title: Excessively gamified and woke
body:
As someone who has been a daily user of Duolingo for over 3 years, I must voice my frustration with the increasingly unnecessary gamification that forces me to constantly click to get through: reward animations that are supposed to trigger some type of dopamine response and are catering towards a TikTok crowd.

Another aspect I can stand about the app is its post-wokeness. Even when learning a language of a country that is not diverse, characters are anything but from that country or of the religion of that country. Also, if it goes by Duolingo, probably more than half of the population should be gay in terms of its relative representation in the app.

Lastly, a few years back, Duolingo still had easily accessible support for premium subscribers. That's also gone, and it's impossible to talk to a person. If any feasible advantage to this app becomes available, I'll make the switch, no doubt.

title: Not ready for prime time
body:
Muse is not ready for prime time. In my experience, it has numerous issues that make even basic tasks frustrating and extremely time-consuming.

It could not reliably identify duplicate photographs or create a complete checklist without repeatedly leaving items out—even when correcting previous omissions.

Organizing photos into groups took more than 24 hours. Each photo required individual approval, making the process far slower than simply doing it myself. Despite all that oversight, there were numerous errors. When I pointed them out, Muse acknowledged that I was correct, but I still had to find the mistakes and work through the corrections.

So far, I have not seen an advantage over ChatGPT. Instead of saving me time and effort, Muse has required constant supervision and rechecking. These are just some of the issues I encountered.

I was very hopeful about Muse, which makes this experience especially disappointing.
